_comment: Invariants every Android release must satisfy. Checked by scripts/verify-release.sh
before any upload to Play Console.
requiredLauncherClass is the load-bearing one. On 2026-07-30, versionCode 7 was built
from a hand-rolled rewrite instead of the real TWA and crashed on launch for every
user. It compiled, it was signed, its versionCode was higher, and its icons were
correct — none of which detects 'this is a different application'. Asserting the
Update lastShippedVersionCode ONLY after a release has actually rolled out on Play.

notes.lastShippedVersionCode: 8 (1.1.1) = the hotfix, live on Play since 30 Jul 2026 20:59. It restored the real TWA after versionCode 7 shipped the wrong application and crashed on launch. Next upload must be 9+.
notes.minTargetSdk: Raise to 36 before 31 Aug 2026 — Play blocks updates below that after then. Do it as its own release, tested on a device, NOT bundled with anything else.
